cells.contract: Immutable AST; combined projections/type constraints checked; no query executes until terminal method.
cells.items: All, None, Filter, Exclude, Q AND/OR/XOR/NOT, Union, Intersection, Difference

cells.contract: Stable ordering required for pagination; deferred data loaded with explicit FetchFields, never magical field access.
cells.items: OrderBy, Reverse, Distinct, DistinctOn, Values, ValuesList, Only, Defer, Slice, Alias, Annotate

cells.contract: Get distinguishes zero/one/many; context-aware iterator closes rows and supports bounded batches; count over scoped query.
cells.items: Get, First, Last, Earliest, Latest, Exists, Contains, Count, InBulk, Dates, DateTimes, Iterator

cells.contract: Ordinary Save does not FullClean; forced UPDATE missing rows returns NotUpdated; ordinary save may INSERT on a missing PK row. Bulk APIs skip Save signals and model cleaning; explicit validation remains available.
cells.items: Create, Save, ForceInsert/ForceUpdate, UpdateFields, Update, GetOrCreate, UpdateOrCreate, BulkCreate, BulkUpdate, Delete, RefreshFromDB

cells.contract: Single transaction for replacement; custom through values validated; relation scope never omitted.
Backend capability checked; explicit connection alias/transaction; uncertain writes not blindly replayed.
cells.items: Using, SelectForUpdate, NoWait, SkipLocked, Of, NoKey, Atomic, OnCommit, Explain, Raw

cells.contract: Bound parameters; empty IN deterministic false; SQL null semantics made explicit in AST.
LIKE metacharacters escaped for literal lookup; regex capability and query timeout enforced.
Timezone-aware casts; immutable query timezone; DST ambiguity policy explicit.
cells.items: Date, Time, Year/IsoYear, Month, Day, Week, WeekDay/IsoWeekDay, Quarter, Hour, Minute, Second

cells.contract: PG operator mapping typed; distinguish JSON null from missing path and SQL NULL.
cells.items: Key, Index, Path, HasKey/Keys/AnyKeys, ContainedBy, Overlap, Length, RangeBounds, Adjacent

cells.contract: Declared output type; no unsafe user SQL fragments; reuse expression in select, update, filters, constraints.
cells.items: F/FieldRef, Value, ExpressionWrapper, Cast, RawExpression, Q, Case/When, Subquery, OuterRef, Exists, OrderBy

cells.contract: Empty/null behavior typed; grouping before HAVING and ordering validated.
cells.items: Avg, Count, Min, Max, Sum, StdDev, Variance; distinct/filter/default

cells.contract: Partition/order and Rows/Range frames plus exclusions checked against dialect.
cells.items: RowNumber, Rank, DenseRank, PercentRank, CumeDist, NTile, Lag, Lead, FirstValue, LastValue, NthValue

cells.contract: Native DB numeric semantics and nulls exposed; no precision downgrade.
cells.items: Abs, ACos, ASin, ATan, ATan2, Ceil, Cos, Cot, Degrees, Exp, Floor, Ln, Log, Mod, Pi, Power, Radians, Random, Round, Sign, Sin, Sqrt, Tan

cells.contract: Hashes are query utilities, not password hashing; extension capability and Unicode/collation differences documented.
cells.items: Chr, Concat, Left, Length, Lower, LPad, LTrim, MD5, Ord, Repeat, Replace, Reverse, Right, RPad, RTrim, SHA1/224/256/384/512, StrIndex, Substr, Trim, Upper

cells.contract: Compile typed arguments; DB clock vs application clock explicit; timezone/collation supplied as validated identifiers.
cells.items: Coalesce, Collate, Greatest, Least, NullIf, JSONObject, JSONArray, Extract, Trunc, Now

cells.contract: Register stable name/output type/compiler capability; no private compiler import required.
cells.items: Custom Lookup, Transform, Aggregate, Function, Manager and QuerySet builder

summary: Proposed contract for architecture review; not implemented.
